link.title: Managing Cloud Projects
link.description: Projects are how work is kept on bitbybit.dev: each holds scripts, in any of the editors, and the files they load. A project lives in the cloud, where it opens on any device and can be shared, or in this browser, where nothing leaves the device. These pages cover what a project is and who can open it, creating one, giving it a cover image, and publishing it to everyone or to a plan's community.
